description: This file implements Neuphonic text-to-speech services, including WebSocket and HTTP streaming integrations, with classes for real-time TTS and HTTP-based TTS, handling connection management, message parsing, and frame processing.

classes.name: NeuphonicTTSService
classes.description: A class providing real-time WebSocket streaming TTS using Neuphonic API, with connection management, frame processing, and support for interruption.

classes.name: NeuphonicHttpTTSService
classes.description: A class providing HTTP streaming TTS using Neuphonic API with server-sent events, supporting connection setup and message parsing.

methods.name: language_to_neuphonic_lang_code
methods.description: Converts a Language enum to a Neuphonic language code string.

methods.name: NeuphonicTTSService.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the WebSocket-based Neuphonic TTS service with API key, voice, URL, sample rate, encoding, and parameters.

methods.name: NeuphonicTTSService.can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates that the service supports metrics generation.

methods.name: NeuphonicTTSService.language_to_service_language
methods.description: Converts a Language enum to a Neuphonic-specific language code.

methods.name: NeuphonicTTSService._update_settings
methods.description: Updates service settings and reconnects WebSocket with new configuration.

methods.name: NeuphonicTTSService.start
methods.description: Starts the WebSocket TTS service and establishes connection.

methods.name: NeuphonicTTSService.stop
methods.description: Stops the WebSocket TTS service and disconnects.

methods.name: NeuphonicTTSService.cancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing TTS and disconnects.

methods.name: NeuphonicTTSService.flush_audio
methods.description: Sends a stop command to flush pending audio.

methods.name: NeuphonicTTSService.push_frame
methods.description: Processes and pushes a frame downstream, handling stop/interruption frames.

methods.name: NeuphonicTTSService.process_frame
methods.description: Processes frames, handling speech control frames like TTSSpeakFrame and BotStoppedSpeakingFrame.

methods.name: NeuphonicTTSService._connect
methods.description: Establishes WebSocket connection to Neuphonic API.

methods.name: NeuphonicTTSService._disconnect
methods.description: Closes WebSocket connection and cleans up state.

methods.name: NeuphonicTTSService._connect_websocket
methods.description: Handles WebSocket connection setup, including URL construction and headers.

methods.name: NeuphonicTTSService._disconnect_websocket
methods.description: Closes WebSocket and resets state.

methods.name: NeuphonicTTSService._receive_messages
methods.description: Receives and processes messages from WebSocket, decoding audio data.

methods.name: NeuphonicTTSService._keepalive_task_handler
methods.description: Maintains WebSocket connection with periodic keepalive messages.

methods.name: NeuphonicTTSService._send_keepalive
methods.description: Sends a keepalive message over WebSocket.

methods.name: NeuphonicTTSService._send_text
methods.description: Sends text message for synthesis over WebSocket.

methods.name: NeuphonicTTSService.run_tts
methods.description: Generates speech frames from text via WebSocket streaming, handling connection, message sending, and audio decoding.

methods.name: NeuphonicHttpTTSService.__init__
methods.description: Initializes HTTP streaming TTS with API key, voice, URL, sample rate, encoding, and parameters.

methods.name: NeuphonicHttpTTSService.can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates support for metrics.

methods.name: NeuphonicHttpTTSService.language_to_service_language
methods.description: Converts Language enum to Neuphonic language code.

methods.name: NeuphonicHttpTTSService.start
methods.description: Starts the HTTP TTS service.

methods.name: NeuphonicHttpTTSService.flush_audio
methods.description: No-op for flushing audio in HTTP service.

methods.name: _parse_sse_message
methods.description: Parses SSE message string into dictionary, handling errors.

methods.name: NeuphonicHttpTTSService.run_tts
methods.description: Streams synthesized speech from text via HTTP SSE, decoding base64 audio data.
